title: SecretStr equality comparison with non-ASCII and surrogate characters
answers: Why does comparing SecretStr with non-ASCII characters raise TypeError?
How to use secrets.compare_digest with unicode strings containing non-ASCII characters or surrogates?
Fix TypeError comparing strings with non-ASCII characters is not supported in SecretStr equality
body:
Symptom: Comparing SecretStr instances holding non-ASCII characters or surrogates raises TypeError: comparing strings with non-ASCII characters is not supported.
Root cause: pydantic/types.py:SecretStr.__eq__ passes str values directly to secrets.compare_digest(), which rejects non-ASCII string arguments.
Fix pattern: Encode strings to bytes with .encode('utf-8', errors='surrogatepass') before passing them to secrets.compare_digest().
Constraints: Applies when using secrets.compare_digest() on unicode strings that may contain non-ASCII characters or lone surrogates; not needed for raw bytes or SecretBytes.
applies: pydantic.types.SecretStr equality and constant-time string comparisons
